description: Brought the purse and the Twelfth Day, and went back to my lord.
name: Ambrose Kettleby

description: Kept Sam out of the telling, and said nobody was threatening the Admiral's.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Landed you, offered three news, and kept the one you did not correct.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Not at the page. Her nights stayed expected.
name: Queen Elizabeth

description: Kept the story inside the length of the bowl, and named the distance home.
name: George Bryan

description: Not at the stair. His Twelfth Day was the one true piece of the three.
name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon

description: Opened the book on two leaves, refused to join them, and stopped the other sentence.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked the question in the new voice, and went with Phillips without singing.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Allowed spoons, and put the company in the street at four.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Left the bowl alone, began a sentence, and stopped when told.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Claimed the inn, told the button with the spoons, and added no moral.
name: Will Kemp

description: Named the lack of a summons, kept the button lost, and took the two hundred yards.
name: William Shakespeare
